approval: D1-D9 approved by the user as recommended on 2026-10-02 (prompt 1b)

reserve_control_only.1: negative control for ES fill-order composition (not evaluated)

scope.decision_compared: threshold decision: calibrated_probability >= B4 v2 per-binding float threshold (full policy not_defined for all 16)
scope.eurusd_calendar_status: provisional eurusd_5m_feed_clock_week_v1; state in every EURUSD report
scope.pass_is_not_scored_eligibility: B6, A12, A13 and B7 still required

preconditions: hash every B4 v2 artifact file and prepared manifest before load; stage manifests outside ote_live/runtime_manifests; a historical app artifact in place of the B4 v2 replacement fails that branch
app path runs on an isolated SQLite parity database (schema + migrations) holding copied canonical bars/source history; the live DB is opened read-only for copying only
scored registration disabled; shadow forced; no broker/paper/alert/email output
record sha256 of harness, runtime and producer modules per run

layers.P: identical source bars through the actual app path (LiveSignalProcessor.process_new_bars_from_store -> IncrementalFeatureEngine -> RuntimeModelRunner -> decision engine) vs the offline reference (historical: frozen source_history.parquet + frozen runner; recorded live: repaired builder on the full contiguous series + frozen runner, after the anchor check)
layers.S: app-recorded bars vs historical training source on overlapping timestamps (D2)
layers.anchor_check: recompute path on historical windows must reproduce frozen source_history.parquet before it is used on recorded live windows; differences are producer drift and are classified first

engine_composition.rule: one shared producer pass per group per segment, then per-model selection; ES runs as the app's two groups because the runtime pruning path rejects an ES all-model union (multiple z-score windows 60/100); EURUSD runs as one union
engine_composition.composition_invariance: F scenario: each group engine vs single-model engines on sampled endpoints; any value difference is app_producer_bug
engine_composition.b6_constraint: B6 must not mix a non frvp_/ict_ XGB model into an ES group, or the composition-dependent ffill+0 must be removed by a versioned fix (D7)

stages.S1: source-bar identity/provenance: timestamp, source_row_idx (consecutive), instrument, contract_symbol, bar_version, is_complete, feed_type, observation_kind, first/last observed
stages.S2: setup events consumed by routes: type, side, family, source timestamp, observed-at, detector identity/version, rule confidence, geometry, revision kind
stages.S3: raw pre-imputation selected features, plus missing-producer/fallback/warmup state
stages.S5: scaled model input after scaler and clip (XGB lag/delta view or TCN sequence tensor)
stages.rows: every consumed row of every compared endpoint (XGB max(lag)+1 rows, TCN window_size rows)

tolerances.rule: pass iff |app - ref| <= atol + rtol*|ref|; NaN matches only NaN; +/-inf only same sign; a missingness-pattern difference is a mismatch

E_exact.applies_to: S1, S7, S2 categorical/timestamps, all states, imputation mask, C0 features

C2_price_level.applies_to: untransformed price levels and S2 geometry

tolerances.feature_classes: pre-assigned per feature in inputs.feature_inventory_tolerance_classes (frozen-data rule, before any comparison)

near_threshold.rule: endpoints with |cal_ref-thr| <= band or |cal_app-thr| <= band are listed with both scores and decisions, never counted as pass or fail; a non-empty list blocks pass until user review; a flip outside the band is an S7 failure

tolerances.change_control: changing any tolerance needs a new protocol version approved by the user with the reason recorded

segments.selection: calendar/event presence only, never outcomes or scores; written to windows.json (hashed) before any comparison
segments.shape_basis: set after measured build time: ES FRVP ~12.7 s, ES ICT ~1.9 s, EURUSD ~78.6 s per build (strategy_signals ~77 s)
segments.prefix: up to runtime_history_bars (8000) earlier bars; for recorded ES windows everything recorded

sources.H: real historical training-source bars (P layer only)
sources.F: deterministic fault injection on R bars where R exists, else H

candidates.roll_H: first contract_symbol change in June 2026 (and March 2026 if another week)

EURUSD.completion: all recorded EURUSD bars have unknown completion; compared as exact value 'unknown'; never counts as known-completion evidence

F_injections.backfill: withhold bars then upsert them behind the cursor as backfill
F_injections.revision: revise the latest bar and an earlier bar behind the cursor
F_injections.restart: fresh processor on the same parity DB at bar k: warm_from_store then process_new_bars_from_store
F_injections.producer_failure: force one feature-set exception / strategy timeout; must surface missing-producer state, never a silent fill

warmup: compare only rows where the app warmup is ready and the reference row exists (EURUSD also past source_row_offset 250); earlier rows counted not compared; warmup state is an exact S3 state; an endpoint with any non-comparable consumed row is incomplete_history, not a pass
restart: real restart path (fresh LiveSignalProcessor/MultiGroupLiveSignalProcessor, warm_from_store, process_new_bars_from_store); post-restart rows must equal continuous bitwise and the reference within tolerance; chunk resumes count as restarts and are allowed only after the stream's restart test passes

execution.chunk_endpoints: per group in engine_composition.groups: min(48, floor(25 min / median build seconds))
execution.chunk_files: chunk_<n>.parquet + chunk_<n>.done (sha256); resume skips finished chunks
execution.background_rule: jobs over ~30 min run in background with a log and a 'SEGMENT <id> COMPLETE' marker
execution.diffs: every out-of-tolerance cell written to diff/; summaries only (counts per stage/feature, first offending timestamp, max abs/rel error, classification) enter reports

retention: keep all app/ref chunks, diffs, summaries and isolated parity DBs (with sha256) until B7 closes; reports in docs/audits permanent and never overwritten; copy only selected segments and prefixes from the live DB (D4)

source_parity.policy: identity, timestamps and completion must match exactly; price/volume differences reported with per-feature and threshold-decision impact; decision flips listed for user review, never auto pass/fail (D2)
source_parity.data: no overlap exists (ES training ends 2026-06-19, live from 2026-07-29; EURUSD 2026-03-25 vs 2026-04-08); create overlap with the app's own backfill connectors into an isolated parity DB: ES IBKR historical 2026-06-01..06-19, EURUSD FMP historical 2026-03-02..03-24; separate client ID, never the running app's session; approved 2026-10-02
source_parity.fallback: if the fetch is impossible, S is incomplete for all 16

setup_events: S2 compared for both streams (D5); ES: app FRVP/ICT detectors on replayed bars vs offline detector events used in section 3; EURUSD: S2 incomplete for 21-26 until a versioned live OTE event producer reusing data/labeling/causal_ote.py exists (later section 4 prompt, minimal runtime change)
eurusd_completion: R1 versioned rule for FMP historical-chart bars: complete when bar end + grace <= observed_at; new recordings and parity replays only; archived rows stay unknown (D6)

runtime_changes_approved_in_principle.D8_provenance: select provenance columns in _fetch_signal_bars_after/_fetch_recent_signal_bars and carry them in _bar_from_row; OHLCV/features unchanged (on/off tests); journal entry
runtime_changes_approved_in_principle.rule: minimal, versioned, value-neutral elsewhere (on/off or before/after tests), logged in docs/live_app_change_journal.md

staged_manifest_bases.23: ote_live/runtime_manifests/long_ote_union_tcn_candidate_20260523 with all artifact/feature/context/lag/window fields from B4 v2 training summary (D9)

app_producer_bug.meaning: app deviates from the causal contract (incl. window truncation, composition-dependent fill, dropped provenance, stale history after backfill/revision)
app_producer_bug.effect: fail until fixed by a minimal versioned runtime change and rerun under a new run id

training_side_noncausal.meaning: frozen reference uses information unavailable at decision time
training_side_noncausal.effect: branch diagnostic; record repair recommendation; stop for user decision; no retraining in section 4

source_difference.effect: not a P failure; reported with impact; flips listed for review

declared_contract_behavior.meaning: behavior follows a contract clause that existed before the run (cite file/version)

mismatch_taxonomy.truth: the causal contract; establish which side is causally correct first; never edit reference data, frozen preprocessing or model bytes; never make an app producer reproduce a non-causal offline value

passed: B4 v2 bytes verified and loaded by the staged manifest
every required scenario of the stream exercised with >=1 comparable endpoint of this model
all S1-S7 cells on every consumed row within tolerance or declared_contract_behavior with citation
no S7 flip outside the near-threshold band; near-threshold list reviewed
provenance and completion present and exact; no unexplained fallback or missing producer
verdict.incomplete: a required scenario unexercised or evidence missing (e.g. unknown completion where known completion is required); not a pass
verdict.failed: any fail class; branch diagnostic/unscored; does not block other branches

fields: windows[]{segment_id, source, rule, start, end, endpoints, comparable_endpoints}
stages{stage: compared, matched, mismatched, max_abs, max_rel, first_offending_ts}
mismatches[]{class, stage, feature, first_ts, count, evidence_path, causal_note}
report_sha256 (canonical JSON without this field; also .sha256 sidecar)

retrain_guard: no retraining/recalibration in section 4; training_side_noncausal -> diagnostic, repair recommendation, stop; IDs 2/6/7/11/17/1 not retrained unless a completed parity audit finds a real selected-feature, history, preprocessing or producer mismatch
